content.page_summary: Reference list (items 352-359) from a clinical guideline discussing trials comparing primary angioplasty, pre-hospital fibrinolysis, and various thrombolytic/anticoagulant regimens in acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI). Trials and reports include GRACIA-2, CAPTIM, ASSENT-2, ASSENT-3 PLUS, GUSTO and other randomized studies; drugs mentioned include tenecteplase, alteplase, enoxaparin and unfractionated heparin.
